subject: ClearBank: Integration-focused walkthrough & demo coordination
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from Redwood webinar — we need an integration-focused walkthrough

Hi Ben / Evelyn,

Thanks for the webinar yesterday — it was really helpful. After chatting with the engineering and security leads this morning, we think a focused integration walkthrough would be the most useful next step. Specifically, we'd like a half-day session (3–4 hours) that covers:

- API authentication and token lifecycle (KMS/HSM integration questions)
- Prefix & KV caching behavior and implications for latency/cost
- Data residency and logs/audit controls (SOC2 evidence we might request)
- SSO metadata and provisioning (SAML/OIDC)
- Example integration code and a quick sandbox runthrough

Would your team be able to run a hands-on session like that? Our initial windows: Friday Apr 16 (morning PT) or Tue Apr 20 (late morning / early afternoon PT). If those don't work we can expand.

I've attached a short spec that outlines our current stack and a few questions to prioritize (named clearbank-integration-specs.pdf).

Attendees from our side will likely include myself (Head of Platform), Marco Ramos (Lead Backend Engineer), and Priya Singh (Security Lead). We may add one more from Product Ops.

Happy to do a 30-minute discovery first if you prefer a quick alignment before committing to a half-day workshop.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform
ClearBank

Attachment: clearbank-integration-specs.pdf (PDF, 450 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbank.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from Redwood webinar — we need an integration-focused walkthrough

Hi Alyssa — great to hear and glad the webinar connected.

We can absolutely run a hands-on integration workshop. My suggestion: schedule a 30-minute discovery call first to confirm scope and participants, then book the 3–4 hour workshop with the appropriate engineers and solutions staff. That helps us prepare the right demo data and avoid wasted time.

Proposed discovery windows: Thu Apr 15 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri Apr 16 10:00–11:00 PT. Proposed workshop windows (if those work for you): Fri Apr 16 11:00–15:00 PT or Tue Apr 20 13:00–16:30 PT.

Can you confirm who from your side will attend the discovery call (and whether Priya or someone from Security will join)? Also, do you prefer a virtual workshop (Zoom) or would you like an interactive runbook we can host in your VPC/private environment?

I’ve linked the HubSpot record here for quick reference: https://hubspot.example/contacts/67890

Thanks — I’ll leave scheduling to Evelyn / Monica once you confirm availability.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Development Rep, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and for sharing the specs. I’m Evelyn (Solutions Architect on the accounts team); I’ll run point on the workshop.

Suggested plan / agenda (we can adjust):
1) 30-minute discovery (objectives & scope, identify security questions and test data)
2) 3–4 hour technical workshop (API keys, SSO metadata exchange, quick sandbox integration, caching and quantization considerations, review of logging/audit capabilities)

Prep checklist for a productive workshop:
- Provision a test account / tenant or provide an account ID we can target
- Example payloads or a short recording of a typical request flow
- SSO metadata (IdP metadata URL or SAML cert) if you want us to demo SSO provisioning
- Point of contact for security/compliance questions (Priya?)
- Confirmation whether any PII/sensitive data must be obfuscated in the sandbox

If you’re evaluating Private/VPC options for data residency, we can touch on that briefly but would request a follow-up with our infra team if you want deep detail.

I’ve attached a draft SOW so you can see what a workshop + follow-up deliverables look like: sow-draft-v1.docx

Scheduling — here are two slots that work for me:
- Fri Apr 16: discovery 10:00–10:30 PT (followed by workshop 11:00–15:00 PT)
- Tue Apr 20: discovery 12:30–13:00 PT (followed by workshop 13:00–16:30 PT)

If you prefer, you can pick times directly on my calendar: https://redwood.app/meet/ev_hart/30 (choose the discovery slot, then we will follow with a longer invite).

Hi Evelyn / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. We’ll take the Tue Apr 20 option and start with the 30-minute discovery at 12:30 PT followed by the 13:00–16:30 workshop. I’ve confirmed internal attendees:

- Alyssa Chen (Head of Platform)
- Marco Ramos (Lead Backend Engineer) — will bring integration details
- Priya Singh (Security Lead) — will drive compliance questions
- Sasha Miller (Product Ops) — will help coordinate notes and follow-ups

Two quick asks before the discovery:
1) Can you send a short pre-read that covers the sandbox provisioning steps and the data obfuscation guidance?
2) Do we need to sign an NDA before the workshop — Priya will flag that if necessary.

If you send a calendar invite to all attendees I’ll accept and loop in any additional engineers if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Alyssa
